ms.report:
All the publications that had to be replaced in our PR roadmap were replaced with a demonstrably comparable publication. 
We replaced Forbes (DA 94) with Bitcoin News (DA 88), because it is a crypto-focused publication, and relevance matters more than raw domain authority when targeting the crypto community. While Forbes has high authority, it caters to a broader Web2 audience; most of whom are not active in crypto, don't own wallets, and aren't likely to convert into valuable Cardano community members. In contrast, crypto-native sites directly reach engaged blockchain audiences more likely to resonate with Cardano’s mission and ecosystem.
It’s important to note that DA ceilings are lower in crypto media: top outlets like Cointelegraph (DA 73) and Coindesk (DA 65) show that even the best in the space don’t come close to Forbes’s DA. Reaching DA 88 in a crypto publication is extremely rare and reflects strong authority within the wider Web3 ecosystem.
Our selected publications (BeInCrypto, Coindesk, Defiant, BSC News, Crypto.News, Bitcoin.com, NewsBTC, and Bitcoinist) consistently deliver higher engagement and conversions aligned with Cardano’s goals. These placements are more effective in activating wallet holders, community members, and developers than more general Web2 traffic.
In short, our aim with this proposal is to prioritize strategic relevance, quality engagement and realistic DA benchmarks targeting crypto-native audience. Forbes (and other Web2-focused publications) do not align with this strategy.
